notes.title: Nintendo Switch Update 2.0 and 2.5- Available Now!
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers!

We have been hard at work for the past months, polishing, optimizing, testing, and now, we have exciting news to share: [b]Sun Haven 2.0 and 2.5 are now available on Nintendo Switch![/b]

After releasing Patch 2.5 to PC/Steam, we’ve managed to get Sun Haven to be in one of the most stable states it’s ever been in. We’ve been working hard on bringing that quality to Nintendo Switch, and we’re ready to release it. Thanks everyone for your patience, there is a lot of work that goes into developing the game for PC, Mac, and Switch!

[b]Sun Haven 2.5.2[/b] includes 5 new seasonal events, 2 new regional events, 400+ new craftable furniture items, changeable flooring, new weapons, and more! The following changes should reflect everything updated on Switch only.

Let's jump on in! 🎉

[*] Seasonal Event: Furniture Festival
[*] Spring Event: Garden Festival
[*] Summer Event: Pet Festival
[*] Fall Event: Mushroom Festival
[*] Winter Event: Snow Festival
[*] Witherball

[*] Breakable Item Update

[*] Updated Catherine Bust
[*] Bug Fixes
[/list]

[*] A new recurring event that appears every season on the 21st
[*] Compete against other NPCs in an auction-style bidding war for new furniture items
[*] New Furniture, Decorations, and Romance Merchants selling large amounts of furniture that rotate every season
[*] Rotating Stalls every season
[*] Added 80 new furniture items
[*] Added 14 new records
[*] Added 1 new pet
[*] Added unique gifting responses for items purchased from the Romance Merchant
[*] Bring your wallet and any extra currencies you may have collected to maximize your visit to the Furniture Festival
[/list]
[b]Spring Furniture Festival Stalls:[/b][list]
[*] Resources Merchant: Sells resources for crafting  of all types from around the world
[*] Records Merchant: Sells records with music from around the world
[*] Armor Merchant: Sells armor, robes, and more
[*] Weapons Merchant: Sells Swords, Crossbows, and more
[*] Great City Technology Merchant: Sells a new robotic pet for your journey
[/list]

[/list]

[/list]
[b]Winter Furniture Festival Stalls: [/b][list]

notes.title: Patch 2.5 on PBE now!
notes.content:
Hi Adventurers!

Happy Summer! I can’t believe spring is already over, it felt like it just got here!

We have exciting news to share: [b]Patch 2.5: Festivals and Crafting is live right now on the PBE (PC only).[/b]

If you’d like a sneak peek at what’s coming in Patch 2.5, you can join the Public Beta Environment (PBE) and help us test this patch out before release! Join our [url=https://discord.gg/as39n4HQ]Discord[/url] and check out #pbe-info for more information on how to opt in! If you experience any bugs on the PBE, please report them in our Discord.

Without further ado, let’s jump into a peek at [b]Patch 2.5: Festivals and Crafting![/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/35pqiLG.gif[/img]
[i]I’ve always wanted to dance with a prince![/i]

[h2]Witherball[/h2]
With a monster city, you need a monster party!

Come one, come all to the one-night-only [b]Witherball[/b] to witness the benevolent Demon King re-crown Prince Darius. Dance with elites from Withergate, or assist Donovan in pulling an epic prank on the royals. The only caveat of the night… don’t get caught!

Once you have purchased your Withergate apartment, you may come across an invitation to this event. Keep your eyes open, the Witherball only comes around once a year on the [b]7th of Fall.[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Z4luI9n.gif[/img]
[i]I have to catch apples for these poor hungry Snaccoons![/i]

[h2]Snaccoon Festival[/h2]
After all those Snaccoons you helped feed, they want to give back with a [b]Snaccoon Festival[/b] dedicated to you. 

As the honored guest, the Snaccoons have much to offer you- delicious snacks fit for any furry friend, clothes that are possibly made with snaccoon fur, furniture… possibly also made with snaccoon fur, wigs that come with the smallest snaccoons atop them. These majestic hungry creatures only ask for one thing in return, help them catch plenty of yummy apples!

Once you have received your Nel’Vari Treehouse, the Snaccoons can plan an elven party, but only during the most magical time of the year. This festival comes around on the [b]7th of Winter[/b], so come hungry!


[img]https://i.imgur.com/YU75ChQ.gif[/img]
[i]Taking out these enemies with a big bang![/i]

[h2]New Weapons: Great Swords and Hammers[/h2]

Raise a sword or even a hammer, young adventurers!

Have you ever wanted to swing a sword like Roza, or slam a hammer down like th strongest of blacksmiths? Now you can with the new craftable [b]Simple Great Swords[/b] and [b]Simple Hammers.[/b] These two-handed weapons might have a slower swing, but their damage is unmatched!

These new weapons can be found at your anvil, ready to be crafted to join the fray!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/lZR7JSv.gif[/img]
[i]Oh, how I love crafting new furniture![/i]
[h2]Monster, Elven, and Updated Furniture Tables[/h2]

Get your hammers ready for a massive update to the furniture game. 

You will now be able to craft over 400 [b]new[/b] furniture and decor items. These items can be found at your Sun Haven crafting tables or from two brand-new tables: the [b]Monster Furniture Table[/b] and the [b]Elven Furniture Table.[/b] These new crafting tables have all new furniture items that match their spook-tastic and nature-ific styles to perfectly outfit your homes around the world.

These new items range from decor to new wallpapers and even new [b]large chests[/b] with extra storage capacity, so get ready to craft!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/MZ4mRCi.gif[/img]
[i]Hmmm… so many choices, how about this one![/i]

[h2]Changeable Flooring[/h2]
Roll out the red carpet- and I mean that literally! 

You can now change your [b]home’s interior flooring![/b] With over 30 options available at the Sun Haven General Store, there is a perfect floor for every home. Along with those options, festival-exclusive flooring is now available, which can perfectly match your festival wallpapers!

So, now you will be able to fully customize your Sun Haven home, Nel’Vari Treehouse, or your Withergate Apartment to your heart’s content!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/KOWDMOi.gif[/img]
[i]Don’t worry, Kara, Wornhardt’s got your back.[/i]

[h2]Worldbuilding Update[/h2]
We wanted to expand on the individual characters in Sun Haven, and take time to explore the depth of their stories.

In this update, you will be able to learn more about the characters and the world in the new [b]worldbuilding update![/b] By investigating strange items around Sun Haven, you can get a glimpse at how characters act when you’re not around. Take a deep dive into their history and learn about how the world is tackling the looming monster city.

Be sure to keep your eye out, you never know where these stories await.

There are more details to come, but if you want to get a chance to see all of this new content before it’s released, the latest content for Patch 2.5 is available now on the [b]PBE for PC only.[/b] Join us on [url=https://discord.gg/as39n4HQ]Discord[/url] for the chance to play them today!

notes.title: Patch 2.0 on PBE now!
notes.content:
Hi Adventurers!

I hope you’re all having a great weekend!

We’re excited to share that [b]Patch 2.0: Festivals is live right now on the PBE (PC only).[/b]  

If you’d like a sneak peek at what’s coming in Patch 2.0, you can join the Public Beta Environment (PBE) and help us test this patch out before release! [b]Join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/sunhaven]Discord[/url][/b] and check out #pbe-info for more information on how to opt in! If you experience any bugs on the PBE, please report them in our Discord.

Curious about whats coming beyond Sun Haven 2.0? Check out our [url=https://trello.com/b/1cqCSkMp/roadmap]Roadmap[/url] for more information on upcoming plans for Sun Haven!

Without further ado, let’s jump into a peek at [b]Patch 2.0: Festivals![/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/h473vMz.gif[/img]
[i]Going once, going twice... SOLD to the farmer in the front row![/i]

[h2][b]Furniture Festival[/b][/h2]
Decorating your farm is one of the highlights of Sun Haven, and this means you need the highest quality furniture around. So be sure to take a trip to the monthly Furniture Festival!

Every season offers a new set of stalls, offerings from all over the world can be found here! Furniture made locally in Sun Haven, some sick records from around the world, a new little robotic pet from the Great City, and more!

All of this boils down to an intense bidding war between you and others from around the world for a chance at some of the most luxurious furniture around. This festival is only available on the 21st of the month, so come with a full wallet and empty pockets!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/4IVQMg9.gif[/img]
[i]Get out of here you pests![/i]

[h2][b]Garden Festival[/b][/h2]
Whether you’re new in town or a well-seasoned farmer, there's nothing a little time at the Garden Festival can’t offer! 

Help Catherine put on one of the prettiest festivals by fending off those pesky Spring pests trying to make a meal of her beautiful flowers! If you can fight off enough pests, you might raise the town’s spirits and be the hero to the local witch! 

The Garden Festival is only found on the 14th of Spring, so be sure to save up for some cute new clothes and plenty of flower seeds to make your farming debut in style.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/sJcpaFp.gif[/img]
[i]Come on Zipps, you can do it![/i]

[h2][b]Pet Festival[/b][/h2]
The rarest pet eggs in the world are brought together just for the one and only Pet Festival! 

Pick out your very own pet egg and hatch a champion in the making. These aren’t just any pets though… these are incredibly athletic pets who are ready to run! Work in sync with your newly hatched companion to race other competitors, but only if you can give your pet the right command to get its tail in high gear! 

The Pet Festival makes its debut on the 7th of Summer, Be sure to stretch before this festival Adventurers! The Summer Pet Festival is the most sporty of them all!


[img]https://i.imgur.com/6ejeuam.gif[/img]
[i]I hope Liam doesn't mind me crashing his photo![/i]

[h2][b]Mushroom Festival[/b][/h2]
You MUSH be in attendance of Sun Haven’s Mushroom Festival!

Who knew that Mushroom folk could put together such a twisting and turning maze? Gear up to find as many mushrooms as you can in a massive fall themed maze. You have to move fast though, everyone is looking for their own mushrooms. If you can find Bernard in the maze, you might even be able to earn a special reward.

The Mushroom Festival might leave you looking for a map, but be sure to pack your own for this adventure on the 14th of Fall.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/BOLcSII.gif[/img]
[i]I wonder who has the best arm on Team Lucia?[/i]

[h2][b]Snow Festival[/b][/h2]
Pull on your winter coats, and get your snowball launchers ready, its time to duel! 

Join Team Lucia or Team Darius in an epic snowball standoff of the century! Try to score direct hits on the enemy team, but avoid their snowballs. 5 hits and you’re out of the battle! So be light on your feet and be quick with your snowballs to earn the win for your team!

The Snow Festival comes around on the 14th of Winter, so come ready for a blizzard battle you will have to remember.

There’s more details to come, but if you want to get a chance to see these new festivals before they’re released, the new content for Patch 2.0 is available now on the PBE for PC only. Join us on [url=https://discord.com/invite/sunhaven]Discord[/url] for the chance to play them today!


Have a festival-filled weekend everyone!

notes.title: Nintendo Switch Release Date
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We hope you’ve been having a wonderful November! With fall comes crispy leaves, cocoa by the fire, bundling up in blankets, and news about the Sun Haven Nintendo Switch release!

Drumroll please…

[h1]Sun Haven will be available for digital purchase in the Nintendo Switch eShop on November 29th, 2024![/h1]
(Americas region only)

You read that right, Sun Haven will be available on the Switch for the Americas region later this month on [b]Black Friday, November 29th, at 7am PST.[/b]

[h3][b]These regions include:[/b][/h3]

[b]The United States, Canada, Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, Chile, Colombia, and Peru.[/b]

For those of you worldwide, we will have more news to share about our release dates outside of the Americas very soon, but rest assured, Sun Haven will be coming to Switch to players worldwide over the next couple of months.

We are happy to be bringing Sun Haven to the Nintendo Switch at 30+ FPS, on par with other beloved games on the Switch, like Breath of the Wild or even Fortnite. Our team has put so much heart and soul into optimizing Sun Haven to make it run just like it would on PC, as indistinguishable as possible. In fact, there are essentially [b][i]zero content differences between the two platforms[/i][/b] as a result of all the amazing engineering work we’ve managed to accomplish. We hope you can see that effort when you get your hands on the Nintendo Switch Edition of Sun Haven later this month!

We’ve also prepared a Switch release FAQ that will hopefully answer any of your burning questions, so keep reading below for more information - including a sneak peek at some gameplay of Sun Haven on the Nintendo Switch!

Let’s jump right into it!

[h2]Sun Haven Nintendo Switch FAQ[/h2]
[olist]
[*][b]When is Sun Haven releasing on the Switch?[/b]
- Sun Haven will be available for digital purchase on the Nintendo Switch eShop on November 29th, 2024 at 7 AM PST.
[*][b]Will there be a physical release?[/b]
- We are not planning a physical release of Sun Haven upon launch, but we are definitely considering the potential for a physical release in the future!
[*][b]Can I pre-order Sun Haven on the Switch?[/b]
- Sun Haven will not be available for pre-order for the Americas region but will potentially have pre-orders for other regions.
[*][b]Is Sun Haven coming to other consoles?[/b]
- We hope to port Sun Haven to other consoles like Xbox and Playstation someday, but right now our focus is on Steam and Nintendo Switch specifically!
[*][b]Will the Switch version have the same content as the Steam version?[/b]
- The Nintendo Switch release of Sun Haven will match what is available right now on Steam at launch.
[*][b]Is the Switch version going to be multiplayer?[/b]
- The Switch version will not have multiplayer at this time, but once Sun Haven is released on the Switch, we will be looking into how difficult it will be to add multiplayer!
[*][b]Will the Switch version support cross-platform saves or cross-play?[/b]
- The Switch version will not have cross-play at this time. Your Steam and Nintendo Switch character save files will be separate!
[*][b]Will the Switch version have translations?[/b]
- Yes! The Switch version of Sun Haven will be available in 19 different languages: Danish, Dutch, English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, Swedish, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, and Ukrainian.
[*][b]Are you still offering Kickstarter key swaps from Switch to Steam?[/b]
- Yes we are! If you want to change your Sun Haven Backer Key from Switch to Steam, please send an email to pixelsproutdistribution@gmail.com and we will work on getting your keys swapped over as soon as possible!
[*][b]When will I get my Kickstarter backer rewards?[/b]
- For those who requested Nintendo Switch keys and are from the Americas, you should receive a Nintendo Switch key at launch. As for the cosmetic rewards, those will be delivered at a later date.
[*][b]Is Sun Haven going to be available on upcoming Nintendo Consoles?[/b]
- Our goal is to have Sun Haven available on all upcoming Nintendo platforms and/or consoles!
[/olist]
Now, who wants to see Sun Haven in all its beautiful, bright-screened glory on the Nintendo Switch?  

[img]https://i.imgur.com/RYN1p0a.gif[/img]
[i]Sun Haven on the Switch? Very cutesy. Very mindful. Very demure.[/i]

Lastly, we want to extend our sincerest apologies for the time that it’s taken to bring Sun Haven to the Switch. The port, development, testing, and approval process has taken far longer than we originally expected or anticipated, and we are very sorry for the delays and the inconvenience to all of our Switch Backers and other players without Steam who haven’t been able to play Sun Haven yet. We spent much of our time making sure that Switch players would not get an older version of Sun Haven, and would get a game that is just as good as the PC version. We completely understand your frustrations, and we’re very sorry for the delays. We are excited for the Nintendo Switch Edition of Sun Haven to be in your hands now!

Because Sun Haven was our first game, it’s safe to say we’ve learned a lot from Sun Haven’s development and publishing, and we will make every effort to improve our development, communication, and publishing going forward. Thank you very much for your continued support, patience, and understanding. We couldn’t do this without you. ❤️

Phew, that was a lot of information, thanks for sticking with us through it all! If you have any other questions, concerns, suggestions, bugs to report, or the desire to make new friends, be sure to join our Discord here: https://discord.gg/sunhaven


Have a wonderful week! We’ll see you soon for the Nintendo Switch release! 🎮

notes.title: Regional Price Adjustments
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We wanted to let everyone know that we’re going to be making some economic adjustments with our pricing. 

We haven’t made any price adjustments to Sun Haven since it was first released in 2021, so as of today, we’ve made adjustments to more closely match Steam’s pricing recommendations for Sun Haven across multiple different regions. This pricing is intelligently created by Steam, is how we initially set the price for the game in all regions, and is how nearly all games on Steam set their localized pricing. Because it’s been several years, some small regions have changed greatly, so in those cases we’ve opted to go lower than Steam’s recommended pricing. Thank you so much for your continued support, and happy gaming!

notes.title: Mac Saves Issue and Cross Platform Cloud Saving
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We've just made a change today that allows [b]Steam Cloud Saves to now transfer across all devices.[/b] If you have multiple Windows and Mac devices, all your saves should now be available across all of your devices (as long as you have Steam Cloud Saving enabled, which should be the default for all Steam users)!

Unfortunately for some Mac Operating Systems, this does involve the save folder moving, meaning that your save file temporarily might not be showing up in game anymore. [b]If you experience this issue, don’t worry, your save file is not deleted or gone![/b]

[b]To fix this issue, please follow these steps:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Go to /Users/YOURUSERNAMEHERE/Library/Application Support/com.PixelSproutStudios.SunHaven and copy your Saves folder
[*] Paste your saves folder into /Users/YOURUSERNAMEHERE/Library/Application Support/Pixel Sprout Studios/Sun Haven
[/olist]
[b]Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]If you are having trouble finding the folder, please use the Finder -> Go To Folder, and try typing the folders above.[/b]
[*][b]If you aren't seeing some of the folders, press “CMD+ Shift +  .”  to view hidden folders.[/b]
[/list]
This should fix your missing saves and return them to normal. Making this move also allows your old saves to make use of the Steam Cloud Saves feature going forward if you’d also like to play on other devices now!.

Thanks everyone for your patience as we continue to improve Sun Haven. We’re sorry that this improvement involves manual work on your end, and in the future, we will try to make it so these types of changes are made automatically for all operating systems.

notes.title: Sun Haven Patch 1.4: New Region, Kids, Romance Update, and the Black Market
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hi everyone, it’s Tavielle here! [/b][/h3]

May came and went faster than usual, it seems. The weather is getting warmer, summer break is upon us, and we know that everyone has been eager for some new content. In other words, it’s the perfect time to release an update!

[b]Sun Haven Patch 1.4: New Region, Kids, Romance Update, and the Black Market[/b] launches today, and it’s packed to the brim with a brand new region to explore, tons of new features, 9 new DLC packs, and a bunch of fixes. Oh, and there is also full controller support for PCs and Steam Decks now. And did we mention[b] translations for Windows, Mac, [i]and[/i] Switch[/b] once Sun Haven’s Nintendo Switch port is complete? 

Yeah. This patch is [i]huge.[/i]

If you didn’t get the chance to read through our Devblog, we also have news about Sun Haven’s Switch release! [b]Patch 1.4 is the final patch filled with major features that will be released before the Nintendo Switch port releases. This means that no major content will be added to Sun Haven after Patch 1.4 until Sun Haven is released on the Switch![/b] 

We’ll still be working on Sun Haven updates in the meantime though, so after Sun Haven is on the Switch, [b]we have another big expansion planned![/b] Keep an eye out for more information from us!


[b]Now, on with the show![/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/bGjMI2J.gif[/img]
[i]The views in the Deeps are espe-shell-y beautiful.[/i]


[b][h1]Patch Highlights:[/h1][/b][list]
[*] Added a new region, the Brinestone Deeps
[*] You can now have one child with your spouse
[*] [b]Added full controller support[/b]
[*] [b]Updated translations and added localizations for Mac OS[/b] 
[*] There are now goodnight kiss cutscenes with your spouse
[*] You can now sleep with your spouse in their spouse room bed
[*] Added longer wedding vows and dialogue 
[*] Added staffs for increased spell damage and more mage equipment
[*] Added solvable riddle quests in Sun Haven, Nel’Vari, and Withergate
[*] Added interactable trash cans around Sun Haven, Nel’Vari, and Withergate
[*] The manhole cover by the Sun Haven Cafe is now open and leads to the sewers
[*] New fish can be caught in the sewers
[*] The Black Market is now accessible via the sewers with a new currency, secret merchants, and more
[*] Added 9 new huge DLC packs
[*] Added the Great Vault that allows you to buy unlimited copies of purchased DLC pack items for in-game gold
[/list]
[b][h1]Sun Haven Patch 1.4:[/h1][/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/53l8PUT.gif[/img]
[i]Awww, my kiddo is hanging out at the Sun Haven library for story time![/i]


[h2]DLC:[/h2]

We are excited to announce that [b]9 new DLC packs[/b] will be available on Steam alongside Patch 1.4!

The [b][i]Pop Sensation Pack[/i][/b] includes:
[b]37 idol Clothing Items, 8 idol Wigs, 16 idol Furniture Items, 1 idol Mount, and 1 idol Pet.[/b] Calling all stans and fans! If you want to be a rising star in the world of pop, then this is the pack for you! The Pop Sensation Pack has [b]63 stylish outfits and luxury furniture items[/b] for you and all of your friends to dress and decorate just like the idols you always knew you were.

The [b][i]Starlight Pack[/i][/b] includes:
[b]32 starry Clothing Items, 7 starry Wigs, 10 starry Furniture Items, 1 starry Mount, and 2 starry Pets.[/b] If you’ve dreamed of being a guardian of the stars, then look no further! The Starlight Pack has an incredible collection of [b]52 starry-themed items[/b] that will make your farm look and feel magical!

The [b][i]Toy Pack[/i] [/b]includes:

notes.title: Patch 1.4 is coming, and it’s our biggest patch ever!
notes.content:
[b]Hi everyone![/b] 

It's Tavielle, from Pixel Sprout Studios!

We’re excited to share another update for [b]Patch 1.4![/b]

[b]The new content for Patch 1.4 is available now on the Public Beta Environment (PBE),[/b] and we’re so close to finalizing the patch for full release soon!

[b]Patch 1.4 will be released once it’s stabilized on the PBE and we’re able to make this massive update as bug-free as possible.[/b] 

Before we take a look at the patch contents, we want to let everyone know that we are still hiring for more sprouts here at Pixel Sprout Studios! Some of our open roles include an Executive Assistant, Level Designer, Pixel Artists, Game Designer, UI/UX Designer, and more. For more information or to apply, please head to our website below! 

https://www.pixelsproutstudios.com/jobs


Now let’s jump into all the new content for Patch 1.4!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Jad4NZF.gif[/img]
[i]A brand new town awaits you from down in the Brinestone Deeps![/i]

[h3][b]Brinestone Deeps:[/b][/h3]
As seen in our Discord and Twitter teasers, there’s an entire new region to explore with two new Romanceables in Patch 1.4!

A mysterious whirlpool has formed in the ocean down near the beach on your farm. Diving into the whirlpool will take you to the new region - a sprawling underwater world inhabited by nautical denizens and giant, lurking beasts. 

If you’re brave enough to traverse the wilderness, you’ll eventually find your way to a sunken city - [b]the Brinestone Deeps,[/b] a town in the midst of a takeover by an eerie and malevolent adversary.

Embark on a brand new adventure to save the Brinestone Deeps, culminating in a battle against this imposing enemy. You’ll meet some new friends along the way, and make a few very important (and very powerful) enemies! As you fight to save the Brinestone Deeps, you’ll be able to access a new Bulletin Board with new Bulletin Board quests, and visit some of the amazing Brinestone shops - including a new general store, a magic staff shop selling weapons for mages, and a magic armor shop to buff up your stats!

Last but definitely not least, [b]after completing the Brinestone Deeps quest line, you will unlock the brand new romanceable characters:[/b] Karish and Zaria.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/dpEl5Ht.gif[/img]
[i]Awww, what a cute baby!![/i]

[h3][b]Kids:[/b][/h3]
Coming in Patch 1.4 is one of the most requested features from the community: Kids! [b]Once you’re married and have your house upgraded to Tier 3,[/b] your spouse can express their interest in having a child. (This is completely optional, and you can say no!)

[b]If you say yes, head to the Wishing Well in Sun Haven’s Eastern Wilderness[/b] to make the wish come true. The following day, a brand new room will appear in your Tier 3 home with a teeny-tiny new occupant. You will need to nurture and take care of your baby to help it grow into a toddler. 

As a toddler, they can explore Sun Haven, have quests, ask you to bring them certain items, hang out with the neighboring children,  and even listen to Jun’s stories at the library! [b]Toddlers are highly customizable,[/b] so you can give them adorable new outfits and customization options to help them fit right into your family. If you welcome the chaos, we’ve also decided to leave all customization options unlocked, just in case you want a half-naga, half-demon baby. Who are we to deny you of your cursed child dreams?!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ABKuJme.gif[/img]
[i]A new currency, secret shops, and new fish to catch in the sewers![/i]

[h3][b]The Black Market:[/b][/h3]
The sewer’s manhole cover to the right of the Sun Haven Cafe is now open and leads to the grungy Sun Haven sewers! Once inside, you can catch sewer-specific fish to make a profit. If you continue forward, you will find the secret Sun Haven Black Market! 

Here you can buy and sell certain items for a unique currency called [b][i]Black Bottle Caps.[/i][/b] These [b]Black Bottle Caps[/b] can be used to purchase furniture, clothing, and even rare eggs that hatch into different pets! There’s also a merchant who will offer to exchange your mana for health or your health for mana, which means all of you min-maxers out there can finally reach the full mana build of your dreams!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/uj2DlMl.png[/img]
[i]The new romanceables are here: Karish the Shark Amari, and Zaria the Water Elemental![/i]

[h3][b]Romance:[/b][/h3]
There are two new Romanceables joining the large cast of Sun Haven in Patch 1.4! 

[list]
[*] [b]Karish, the Aspiring Hero[/b] - A Shark Amari who looks for the best in this harsh world, Karish aspires to be the hero the Brinestone Deeps needs. Can this over-eager hero in training learn to temper expectations and help his community in ways that really matter?
[*] [b]Zaria, the Redwash Mercenary[/b] - A Water Elemental known beneath the waves for her cutthroat attitude, Zaria has learned that loyalty is best sold for cash and friendship is a fool's dream. But does she truly feel that way, or is there something this ruthless corsair is trying to hide?
[/list]
These new characters have dates, events, bulletin board quests, and tons of new dialogue for you to experience!

These two new romanceable characters aren’t all we have in store! We’ve also updated many aspects of romance in Sun Haven, starting with being able to [b]sleep in the same bed as your spouse![/b] Once your spouse moves into your Tier 3 house, you now have the option to sleep in your spouse’s bed. You can also [b]share a special kiss with your partner[/b] in new [b][i]goodnight kiss cutscenes[/i][/b] before turning in for the day. How sweet!

There are also [b]new seasonal walk path animations[/b] for all romanceable characters that will breathe life into the world of Sun Haven. Some of these animations include Claude playing the piano, Lucia sitting at her desk signing papers, Anne polishing a diamond, and more! These animations aren’t just seasonal - they also add ways for you to connect with the traits, hobbies, and magic of the Romanceables in Sun Haven.

Romanceable characters will now have [b]positive and negative reactions when you accept or decline hangout and date requests![/b] Additionally, spouses now have unique vows and more dialogue during your wedding, as well as rejection responses if you decide to say no to getting married at the altar. [i](You monsters!)[/i] 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/sacBOzg.gif[/img]
[i]Sharing a wholesome kiss with my sweet, scaly husband.[/i]

[h3][b]Miscellaneous Updates:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*][b][i]Added the Great Vault![/i][/b] Gone are the days of running out of or misplacing DLC items, because now you can literally jump right into your Sell Portal and be whisked away to the Great Vault, the jewel of the Great City! Here, you can also browse all of the DLCs in Sun Haven, buy extra DLC pack items for gold, and get taken directly to the DLC Steam Store pages to browse the full selection of DLC packs available.

[*][b][i]Added Trash Cans and Destructibles.[/i][/b] There are now interactable trash cans around Sun Haven, Nel’Vari, and Withergate. Be careful not to get caught digging through the trash, though… unless you don’t mind hearing rumors about your stinky behavior. Additionally, there are new crates and barrels around all [b]4 towns[/b] (Hehe, you read that right! FOUR towns now!) that can be hit with your sword or scythe. Once broken, they can drop materials and other items!

[*][b][i]Added Riddle Quests.[/i][/b] Discover new puzzles and riddles that have been hidden around the world! These new riddles offer exclusive rewards, so keep your eyes peeled for these secret quests.

[*][b][i]Various bug fixes.[/i][/b]We’ve fixed tons of bugs and other issues, including: automatic collectors, automatic feeders, and feeding stations not working as intended, Shang’s first date causing you to get accidentally murdered by enemies, removed the Farmer Table’s spooky ghost animation issue, quest items not being given, Snaccoons going missing, miscellaneous typos, crafting issues with health, mana, and fish, and more!
[/list]
Starting now, [b]Patch 1.4’s new content is live on the PBE.[/b] If you’d like to see all the new content coming in Patch 1.4, you can join the Public Beta Environment (PBE) and help us test the patch before release! Join our [b][url=https://discord.gg/sunhaven]Discord[/url][/b] and check out [b]#pbe-info for more information on how to opt in![/b]

On a development note, we’re so excited to share that [b][i]Patch 1.4 is the final patch filled with major features that will be released before the Nintendo Switch port releases. This means that no major content will be added to Sun Haven after Patch 1.4 until Sun Haven is released on the Switch![/i][/b] 

Any fixes that the community helps us with for this patch will help improve the Switch build, and we are very appreciative of everyone taking time to help us test out all of the new content that was introduced in this patch.

Thank you so much for your patience as we’ve worked behind the scenes to bring all of these major features and updates to Patch 1.4! This is the biggest update we’ve ever had, and we’re so excited to finally share it with you all!

Have a great week, and we’ll see you soon for the full release!

[b]Tavielle, Community Manager[/b]
[b]Pixel Sprout Studios[/b]

notes.title: Sun Haven Patch 1.3: New Romanceables and Farm Buildings
notes.content:
[b]Hey Everyone![/b]

It’s Tavielle, the Community Manager for Sun Haven!

We’re excited to announce that [b]Sun Haven Patch 1.3: New Romanceables and Farm Buildings is now available on Steam![/b] This patch includes 3 New Romanceables, tons of new Farm Structures and Crafting Stations, Player Birthdays, a Combat Arena with Multiplayer Boss Battles, 6 New DLC Packs, major optimization improvements, an Encyclopedia for pets, mine progress, and items, and more!

This text is not translated yet, but we’re working to bring these new translations to PC as soon as possible!

[b][h1]Patch Summary:[/h1][/b]
[list]
[*] Added 3 New Romanceable Characters
[*] [b]Major optimizations for faster load times and reducing system stress[/b]
[*] Added Race-Specific Dialogue
[*] Added Time Pausing in Chests
[*] Added an Encyclopedia Tab in the menu
[*] Added More Weather Patterns and Weather Sound Effects
[*] Added Player Birthdays and Birthday Celebrations
[*] Added 10+ Farm Structures and Buildings
[*] Added 12 New Shed Skins and 30+ House Customization Sets
[*] Added Combat Arena with Boss Fights
[*] Added Nel’Vari and Withergate Fruit Trees
[*] Added Ambient and Proximity Animations to Sun Haven and Withergate
[/list]

[b]There’s a lot that we have to share, so let’s jump right into Patch 1.3’s highlights![/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/EiwE8m6.gif[/img]
[i]Shang, Miyeon, and Lucius are looking extra dreamy in their summer outfits![/i]

[h3][b]New Romanceable Characters[/b][/h3]
The three new romanceables are finally here! You will have the option to romance and marry two brand new characters, as well as another that you may have met already...

[list]
[*] [b]Shang, the Righteous Swordsman[/b] - Coming to Sun Haven with a mysterious mission, Shang spares words and forms bonds very carefully. Living under a personal code of strict honor, this swordsman may find himself forced to make a decisive choice in the fate of his future.
[*] [b]Miyeon, the Timid Angel[/b] - A new arrival in Sun Haven, Miyeon has moved to town with her accomplished parents. Living under the pressures of perfection, the anxious angel has quite the journey to spread her wings and fly.
[*] [b]Lucius, the Moon Attendant[/b] - The Attendants to the Moon are a special caste of Nel’Varians that exist outside the village’s normal livelihood. The Moon Elf Lucius has learned not to expect the companionship of outsiders, though this isn’t to say he isn’t hopeful…
[/list]
Each new Romanceable has their own unique dates, cutscenes, dialogue, keepsakes, and wedding rings! These characters also have certain unlock requirements. Be sure to talk to other NPCs and continue through the main quests to meet these amazing new characters!
[b]To unlock Shang,[/b] you’ll need to be on Day 8 or later, complete Peter’s A Special “Fish” quest, and then enter your farm to receive a quest that will lead you to Shang.
[b]To unlock Miyeon,[/b] you’ll need to be on Day 11 or later, complete Solon’s Plan in Action quest, then enter the Town Hall to meet Miyeon.
[b]To unlock Lucius,[/b] you’ll need to progress the main story and travel to Nel’Vari. His home can be found next to the Grand Tree.

For those of you who are achievement hunters, these new romanceables also bring new Steam Achievements!

We’re so happy to see all the excitement around the new Romanceable Characters. [b]We’re excited to share that we have two more unannounced Romanceables coming later this year.[/b] Stay tuned for more information!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/P3d7Udi.gif[/img]
[i]Now the seasons feel even more alive![/i]

[b]Farm Buildings[/b]
Who doesn’t love an organized farm? We’re excited to share that Patch 1.3 has over 10 brand-new Farm Structures, Buildings, and Crafting Stations.  These structures can be used to help you process materials, store crafting stations, grow crops, or simply to help decorate your farm. [b]These buildings include seasonal Greenhouses, Silos, Chicken Coops, Butterfly Gardens, Workshops, Ticket Counterfeiters, Mana Siphoners, and even Glorite Siphoners![/b] 

The seasonal Greenhouses can be used to plant crops from their respective seasons! You can have one of each season, and it even comes with its own built-in waterfall and farm area. The new Chicken Coop and Nel’Vari Butterfly Garden are mini barns that not only look beautiful, but they also increase your animal limit and can be used to house Chickens and Silk Moths inside. The new crafting tables are for all you troublemakers out there who have to resort to your own underhanded devices to create your own Tickets, Mana, and Glorite against the usual forest gathering method. These crafting tables are simple and don’t take many resources to gain extra currency!

We’ve also added [b]12 new Shed Skins[/b] to help you theme and decorate your farm just how you like it! Some of our favorites include the Beehive Shed, the Mushroom Shed, the Ghost Shed, the Pumpkin Shed, and the Cake Shed. Sheds now also have Night Lighting to brighten up your farm area in the evenings! Additionally, thanks to player feedback, [b]we’ve increased the Shed limit from 4 total Sheds to 12 total Sheds.[/b] Now you can make even more creative farm layouts!

Speaking of building decorations, we’ve also added over [b]30 new House Customization Set options,[/b] which means you can mix and match hundreds of new combinations! Some of our favorites include the Cottage Core set, the Charming set, the Castle set, and the Log Cabin set. We can’t wait to see all of your new creations!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/hnVCSeK.gif[/img]
[i]These shed nightlights will look amazing next to my Nel’Vari Butterfly Garden![/i]

[h3][b]Player Birthdays:[/b][/h3]
Birthday parties [i]and[/b] gifts? Yes please! You can now choose a birthday when creating a new character, or if you’re playing on an older save, you can change your birthday once at the Town Hall. On the morning of your chosen birthday, you’ll be visited by Ronald, the Sun Haven Tavern’s Barkeep. He’ll ask you to swing by the Tavern that day - if you decide to go, you’ll be able to celebrate your birthday surrounded by your friends and other invited guests. 

[i][b]Don’t forget to empty your inventory before you go![/b][/i] The more romanceable characters you befriend, the more people you’ll have at your party - which means you’ll get even more unique gifts at the end of your birthday celebration!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Gfjat7L.gif[/img]

Some of these packs are even larger than the ones we released last patch, so get ready for some amazing items! [b]Let’s take a look:[/b]

The [b]Trick or Treat Pack[/b] contains over [b]35 items,[/b] including a furniture set, 10 new outfits, 1 mount, and 1 pet. This spooky-themed pack will give you a cozy fall feeling year-round. Ride around on a ghost, have a mini ghost companion follow you around, and decorate your farm to look scary good!

The [b]Spirit Petal Pack[/b] contains over [b]30 items,[/b] including a furniture set, 8 new outfits, 1 mount, and 1 pet. This fae-themed pack will give your farm a mystical touch. Ride around on a koi fish, tend to a fae spirit pet, and decorate your house to feel like it’s been touched by elemental energy itself!

The [b]Rock ‘n’ Roll Pack[/b] contains over [b]45 items,[/b] including a furniture set, 5 new outfits, 1 mount, and 1 pet. This Rock ‘n’ Roll pack will give you all the gear you need to look the part as you shred through Sun Haven with musical power. Ride around on a punk-rock horse, pet a heavy metal rat, and show everyone that your Rock ‘n’ Roll interior design isn’t just a phase.

The [b]Cyberpop Pack[/b] contains over [b]55 items,[/b] including a furniture set, 10 new outfits, 1 mount, and 5 pets. In this Cyberpop Pack you’ll find an assortment of outfits and gadgets to take you a century (or five) into the future. Ride around on a hoverboard, pet some robotic and cyber-academia creatures, and decorate your farm to feel like a futuristic paradise.

notes.title: Patch 1.3 on PBE now!
notes.content:
[b]Hi everyone![/b] 

It's Tavielle, from Pixel Sprout Studios!

We’re excited to share an update for [b]Patch 1.3![/b]

[b]Patch 1.3 is available now on the Public Beta Environment (PBE),[/b] and we’re making great progress on finalizing the patch for release after it’s finalized on the PBE!

[b]Patch 1.3 will be released once it’s stabilized on the PBE and we’re able to make the patch as bug-free as possible.[/b]

Before we take a look at the patch, Pixel Sprout Studios is hiring more sprouts! Some of our open roles include a UI/UX Designer, Level Designer, Pixel Artists, Game Producer II, and more. For more information, or to apply for a role, please head to our website below! 

https://www.pixelsproutstudios.com/jobs


Without further ado, let’s jump into a sneak peak for Patch 1.3!


[img]https://i.imgur.com/DPSS5JZ.png[/img]
[i]The New Romanceables are here - Shang, Miyeon, and Lucius![/i]


[h3][b]New Romanceables:[/b][/h3]
Coming with Patch 1.3 are 3 new romanceables joining the large cast of Sun Haven characters! We’ve expanded our world with Shang, the Righteous Swordsman, Miyeon, the Timid Angel, and Lucius, the thoughtful Moon Attendant. These new characters have dates, events, bulletin board quests, and tons of new dialogue for you to explore!

[h3][b]Farm Structures:[/b][/h3]
We’re introducing a plethora of new structures to place around your farm in Patch 1.3! These farm structures can help you out in a bunch of different ways, not only as decorations but with some extra effects as well! Some of these buildings include seasonal Greenhouses, Silos, Chicken Coops, Ticket Counterfeiter, Glorite Mining Machine, Butterfly Gardens, and more! [i]Thanks to player feedback, we are also increasing the Shed limit to 12,[/i] so you can decorate your farm to your heart’s content!

In addition to the new structures, sheds now have beautiful night lighting to brighten up your areas in the evenings and to liven up your farm! With the increased shed limit, we’ve also added even more Shed Skins and House Customizations to choose from. We can’t wait to see your creative farm layouts!


[img]https://i.imgur.com/17aT22B.gif[/img]
[i]New shed skins, chicken coops, and seasonal greenhouses? Yes please![/i]


[h3][b]Player Birthdays:[/b][/h3]
Everyone deserves to be celebrated on their birthday, so we’ve added a yearly event that does just that! On the morning of your birthday (which is chosen in character customization and can only be changed in the Town Hall once, so choose wisely!), you’ll receive a surprise visit from Ronald, the local Tavern’s barkeep. Head over to the Sun Haven Tavern to celebrate your birthday surrounded by your friends and other guests of Sun Haven. The more NPCs you befriend, the more people you’ll have show up to your party! Be sure to come empty with an empty inventory though, because your friends may have gifts for you!


[img]https://i.imgur.com/vcEsw3N.gif[/img]
[i]Celebrate your birthday at the Sun Haven Tavern![/i]

[h3][b]Miscellaneous Updates:[/b][/h3]
[list][*][i][b]Updated Weather Effects and Animations.[/b][/i] There are quite a few new seasonal weather effects that have been added, including light and heavy rain, light and heavy snow, and foggy and windy days, and themed seasonal particles around the maps of Sun Haven, Nel’Vari, and Withergate!  [b]Weather sound effects have also been added, which means that rain will finally make rain sounds![/b]
[*][i][b]Withergate and Nel’Vari Fruit Trees.[/b][/i]We’ve added a whole bunch of different fruit trees that can be purchased from Christine in Withergate and Clemmett in Nel’Vari. These fruit trees can also be found around the map as you’re exploring!
[*][i][b]Added Proximity Animations.[/b][/i]We wanted to make the world of Sun Haven feel more alive, so we’ve now added proximity animations to tons of areas in Sun Haven and Withergate. You’ll now see banners waving, trees moving, windows shining, and more as you adventure through the world! You can expect to see us continue to add more animations in future patches as well.
[*][i][b]Various bug fixes.[/b][/i]We’ve fixed tons of bugs and other issues, including digging up floor tiles in Nel’Vari, crop growths not syncing, tons of multiplayer bugs, quest and dialogue typos, controller support issues, and more![/list]
Starting now, [b]Patch 1.3 is live on the PBE.[/b] If you’d like a sneak peek at what’s coming in Patch 1.3, you can join the Public Beta Environment (PBE) and help us test this patch out before release! Join our [b][url=https://discord.gg/sunhaven]Discord[/url][/b] and check out [b]#pbe-info for more information on how to opt in![/b] If you find any bugs on the PBE, please report them in our Discord so we can get Patch 1.3 released as soon as possible!

Thanks for your patience as we’ve worked behind the scenes to bring all of this content to Patch 1.3!

Have a great week! See you soon for the full release!

[b]Tavielle, Community Manager
Pixel Sprout Studios[/b]

notes.title: Patch 1.2: Romance and Barns Update
notes.content:
[b]Hey Everyone![/b]
It’s Bruce, the Director of Sun Haven.

We’re excited to announce that [b]Patch 1.2: Romance and Barns Update is now available on Steam![/b] This patch includes upgradeable barns and new farm animals for Nel’Vari and Withergate, 3 new Romanceable Characters, decorative sheds, exterior house customization, updated UI, overnight cutscene events, some new cosmetic DLC packs, and more! 

[i][b]Disclaimer: the patch is currently available for all languages, but new items and text will only be in English for a short period of time until we can get it translated![/b][/i]

Let’s jump right in!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/J5TNjEZ.gif[/img]
[i]The new DLC mounts are adorable![/i]


[h2][b]Barns and Animals Update:[/b][/h2]
As we talked about in the sneak peek, previously players have only been able to have four Tier 1 barns in Sun Haven. This patch, you can now upgrade your barns all the way up to Tier 3 allowing them to look cooler, have more interior space, and hold more animals! Each upgrade to each barn gives an additional 8 slots for barn animals.

Additionally, there are also some brand new regional barns - you can now place (and upgrade!) up to 4 Elven Barns in Nel’Vari, or even own a Sewer Barn in Withergate! 

To go along with all the newly upgraded barns, we’ve added some more brand-new animals and creatures that you can buy for your farm to help you collect resources and other items. There are 5 new Nel’Vari animals that can be purchased from Fonzo, and 8 new Withergate animals that can be purchased from Ur, a new Vendor in the Withergate Sewer.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/hdY3SGi.gif[/img]
[i]These animals will be a lot more comfortable in my upgraded barn![/i]


[h2][b]New Romanceable Characters[/b][/h2]
Three new Romanceable characters have been added as well! You will have the option to romance and marry two brand new characters, and one you may recognize from before... :

	[b]Kai, The Wayward Naga[/b] - Since washing up on shore in Sun Haven, Kai may not remember much about his past, but with your help, he might discover more about himself.
	[b]Vivi, The Bounty Hunter[/b] - A klutzy assassin out for the high bounty on your [strike]heart[/strike] head. Now with getting to know her, maybe you’ll find out who placed the bounty…
	[b]Wesley, The Elven Historian[/b] - This familiar face has found commonality with many people from our community, but can you get him to open his heart?

Each new Romanceable has their own unique dates, cutscenes, dialogue, keepsakes, and wedding rings! These characters also have certain features needed to be able to unlock them. For Kai, you’ll need to reach Summer Year 1. For Wesley, you’ll need to complete the Commonality questline in Nel’Vari, and for Vivi, you’ll need to complete the Glorite Miners encounter in Withergate (yes, the one in Withergate!). So be sure to keep your eyes open, talk to other NPCs, and continue through the main quests to find these new characters!

[b][i](Also note: Wesley's Dialogue is now reset!)[/i][/b]

For those of you who are achievement hunters, these new characters also bring new Steam Achievements!

Since announcing the three new Romanceable Characters, we’ve seen a lot of player suggestions for some more beloved characters to become romanceable, and [b]we’re excited to share that we have several more Romanceables coming later this year. Stay tuned![/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vLFbWIk.gif[/img]
[i]Look at them all, so cute![/i]


[h2][b]Farm Building Customization[/b][/h2]
Sheds are a brand new way to customize your farm and add a bit more storage! [b]Sheds can be crafted at a Construction Table[/b] along with the different kinds of shed skin kits which can let you change how the exteriors look. These sheds have fully customizable interiors as well, so you can store items, create role play spaces, match them to your farm, or even live in them if you want!

You can also have up to 4 on your farm at once, so you can set them up anywhere and make your own story.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/kqCE6Jz.gif[/img]
[i]These are perfect to make your adventure match your farm![/i]


[h2][b]Player House Customization[/b][/h2]
A brand new store has opened up in Sun Haven, [b]the Hardware Store[/b]! Here you can buy individual pieces of customization for your house to change its exterior look and appearance. Lewis, the new store owner, is selling over 135 unique roofs, walls, windows, doors, and patios, so be sure to stop by and take a look at what he has for sale! 

This feature has already been receiving overwhelmingly positive feedback, and we are happy to announce that we’ll be adding even more House customization in a future patch as well. So if you have any suggestions or ideas for house exteriors you’d like to see, please let us know over on our Discord!

[i]Note: The house customization is only available for your Sun Haven house, and will not affect your Nel’Vari Tree House or Withergate Apartment.[/i]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/8vNL4j1.gif[/img]
[i]Mix pieces to make new combinations or stick with a matching set![/i]


[h1][b]4 New DLC Packs:[/b][/h1]
We are excited to announce [b]4 new DLC packs[/b] will be available on Steam very soon, including a FREE Snaccoon Costume DLC! (Yes, that’s right, it’s free!)

These packs are quite a bit larger than the ones we released last patch, so buckle your seatbelts, or should I say, raise the sails for these new packs! [b]Let’s take a look:[/b]


[h3][b]Free Snaccoon Costume DLC[/b][/h3] contains a full Snaccoon outfit - hat, shirt, pants, gloves, and a [i]tail![/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/tjZueex.gif[/img]
[i]Just two Snaccoons hanging around![/i]

[h3][b]Set Sail DLC[/b][/h3] contains over 40 items, including a furniture set, 8 new outfits, 2 mounts, and 3 pets! This Pirate-Themed pack will put the ARRR in are you kidding me with how cool these mounts are?! Ride on the back of a Parrot, pet a monkey, and make your farm a swashbuckler’s paradise!

[h3][b]Mushy DLC[/b][/h3] contains over 40 items, including a furniture set, 15 new outfits, 1 mount, and 1 pet. This Mushroom-Themed pack will make you a fun-gi with the perfect cottage-core vibes. Ride a Mushroom Frog, dress up in the coziest mushroom-inspired clothes, and pet your very own Booshroom!

[h3][b]Ocean Shores DLC[/b][/h3] contains over 30 items, including a furniture set, 7 new outfits, and 1 mount. This Beach-Themed pack will be sure to make you ready for summer with clothes perfect for the hot weather! You can, mermaid-ify your farm, ride on the back of a manatee, and enjoy the season with this DLC.

notes.title: Patch 1.1 Micropatch
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone! It's Bruce, from Pixel Sprout Studios.[/b]

First off, thank you and welcome to our new and returning players this past week! We love to see everyone enjoying Sun Haven, and we’re so glad you’ve loved the 1.1 update. This patch we tried some changes to [b]make controller better for all the new Sun Haven who were having trouble with casting spells[/b]. However, we've heard your feedback (mostly from returning players), that the new cast system was just simply too slow. As such, we're releasing this [b]micropatch to address that community feedback[/b], as well as fix up a few things we had on our list.

This post is to keep the community updated to make sure you’re all in the loop. [b]and to make it very clear that we’ve heard your feedback in these past 24 hours.[/b] 

Now, we are happy to announce that these changes are now live:

[h1][b]Patch 1.1 Micropatch Notes[/b][/h1]

[list]
[*] Controls for casting spells are being reverted back to the original quickcast system
[*] Controller controls are being reverted back to the original bindings
[*] Walking into the Altar Room with 7 or more altars completed will trigger the Epilogue quest (which means you won’t have to complete all 9 altars!)
[*] If you chose combat with Dynus, you’ll have to defeat him again to trigger the Epilogue quest (but you can do this with invincibility on, if you’d like)

[/list]

Come early next week, we will deploy another micropatch (likely without any patch notes as it is expected to be rather small) to fix up some other minor issues, including the End of Day Screen not working in certain situations, as well as some language translation issues in a small number of languages! :) 


Have a great rest of the weekend, everyone!

[b]-Bruce, Director at Pixel Sprout Studios[/b]

notes.title: Patch 1.1: Epilogue, Translations, and Customization
notes.content:
[b]Hey Everyone!

It’s Bruce, the Director of Sun Haven.
[/b]
We’re excited to announce that Patch 1.1: Epilogue, Translations, and Customization is now available on Steam! This patch includes Sun Haven’s Epilogue to the story, 15 new language translations, more player customization, more pets, new mounts, updated RNPC interiors, and Volume 2 of the Sun Haven Soundtrack.

[i]Sun Haven will also be on sale for two weeks starting tomorrow morning![/i]

Let’s jump right into the new patch!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/3crK3BB.gif[/img]
[i]What in the world happened to Wesley!?[/i]

[h3][b]Epilogue[/b][/h3]
Every epic story deserves an equally epic ending, and that’s just what we’ve got for you all in Patch 1.1! 

Once you have handled ever-spreading darkness from Dynus, Sun Haven can finally celebrate in peace. Though it seems your job is not done yet, because there’s unfinished business in Withergate and Nel’Vari that requires action! With the help of some old friends, you might just be able to make things right with the Elven Village and Monster City.


[i][b]Note: If you're continuing a game from a previous save file, players who have already fought Dynus will need to fight him again, and players who chose to complete 7 altars will need to complete the final 2 in order to trigger the new Epilogue Quest.[/b][/i]

[h3][b]Translations and Localization[/b][/h3]
Thanks to the additional help from our Sun Haven Discord community, we’re ready to introduce translations to Sun Haven! Players will now be able to change their language in the settings menu to the following languages: English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Russian, Dutch, Danish, Portuguese, Traditional Chinese, Ukrainian, Turkish, Polish!

We want to give a big thank you to [b]PotatoePet[/b], one of our[b] awesome community members[/b] for the help. This was a massive undertaking that has taken[b] several months[/b], and is only made possible thanks to the hard work by PotatoePet. In collaboration with our programmers, we were able to get this mod [b]integrated into the vanilla version of the game[/b] so that players worldwide can now enjoy the story and entire game of Sun Haven in their own languages. We are incredibly excited to bring our game into the hands of players everywhere, and are super thankful for you PotatoePet, and the rest of our awesome community! We will be [b]continuing to bring even more translated languages to Sun Haven[/b] in the future as well, so let us know which languages you’d like to see Sun Haven in next!

[i][b]Note: A lot of these translations are computer-generated, so there may be inconsistencies or inaccuracies due to limitations.[/b][/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/pU4Jral.gif[/img]
[i]So many more options to pick from![/i]

[h3][b]Even More Character Customization[/b][/h3]

We have also added in even more hairstyles for most races, “none” options, and face accessories beyond just beards and mustaches. There are also over 25 brand new hairstyles to try out! Additionally, you can now select nothing in the place of many race features such as horns, halos, wings, and more; allowing even more options and combinations as you create your character. Along with that, you can also select new face customization for many races, including makeup, masks, headbands, tattoos, glasses, and more!

For those of you looking for something with a bit more bark, we have also added a lot of new pets to the Sun Haven, Nel’Vari, and Withergate Pet Stores. You can now find over 135 pets between the three cities! To go along with all of those new pets, there are also new mounts to buy that can accompany you on your adventures throughout Sun Haven, Nel’Vari, and Withergate!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/64VpsYD.gif[/img]

notes.title: 1.0.2 Micropatch

Hey all! 

[b]It's Bruce the Director at Pixel Sprout Studios.[/b]

First off, thank you and welcome to all of our new players this last week! The support is overwhelming and we're incredibly grateful and excited to see all the new folks playing our beloved game. As a game dev, watching people enjoy your game is just absolutely heartwarming. Thank you!!


Now, to quickly get in to the post, we just released a micropatch to [b]address some of the bugs from the release![/b] Some of our patches are "[b]ghost patches[/b]", which mean we micropatch some bugs without posting an actual patch notes here on Steam. Other times though (like now!), we release some minor changes with a Small Game Updates post like this one. notes.title: Patch 1.0: Museum and Customization
notes.content:
Hey Everyone!

[b]It’s Bruce, the Director of Sun Haven.[/b]

Today is the day! The team is happy to announce that we are finally releasing [b]Patch 1.0: Museum and Customization[/b] on Steam! This is our full release patch, which means we're packing tons of polish, as well as the Museum and Character Customization that we’ve been working on for a while! In fact, we’ve more than doubled some of the character customization options, like hair! Let's jump in! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/DCq3EYl.gif[/img]

[b]Character Customization[/b]
The world of Sun Haven is diverse, home to many different races of people that encompass many different walks of life. Whether your Demon is a battle-hungry warrior or a gothy partygoer, Sun Haven reflects many aesthetics. To expand this even further, we’ve added new customization options so you can make your character to your precise taste.

There are many new hair options, new customization options for races, and new options to disable certain customizations (such as wings and horns!). There are also new color customizations for things like Angel halos and Amari ears as well. Create a new character or visit the salon in Sun Haven to explore the vast expansion of player customization!


[b]The Museum[/b]
The gilded doors of the Sun Haven museum have finally been opened. Its vast halls of histories and knowledge are waiting to enlighten curious visitors. But there’s one problem… it’s missing all of the displays! You’ll need to help Covington, the jovial curator of the museum, fill out the missing displays and prepare the museum for a proper opening. It’s a good thing you happen to be a magic-wielding adventurer with a penchant for collecting ancient treasure.

Your generous contributions won’t go without reward, of course. Complete displays by finding and donating collections of different item types, earning wonderful and unique rewards for your hard work.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/YnKfMKB.gif[/img]

____

Returning players who selected Dog and Cat Amari will have to revisit the salon in order to re-select their character customization for certain things like ears (as we needed to change how some of the customization worked in order to have more options).[/i]

[i]Wow, these are some spooktastic costumes![/i]

Now, you can spend the day (or weeks) in the different regions, scouring the forests to find new trees, rocks, and breakable items to score some of these new craftable items.

Also, you should even check the waters around Sun Haven… who knows what new creatures may be lurking beneath the waves. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/yXARfFX.gif[/img]
[i]Ack! Is that a fish or a Fish-sicle?![/i]

[h2][b]1.0 Announcement[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Sun Haven Patch 1.0 is set to release on March 10th, 2023![/b][/h3]

It’s finally that time. 

The big pieces of content for the 1.0 Release will be the Museum, and updated character customization! For all you completionists out there, now is the time! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/gMF4bDd.png[/img]
[i]A sneak peek at the Culture Section at the Museum![/i]


While we are going to be releasing these two big things, the majority of our time will be going towards bug fixes, optimizations, and polish.

If you run into any bugs after the release of Patch 0.8, please pop into discord to share them with us.

From [b]Wednesday, February 21st[/b] until the final build for the release, we will be extra active in our discord, as we’ll be trying to polish up everything we can. For these next few weeks, please feel free to come by and post anything you want to see fixed in the #community-suggestions channel. [b]We’ll add it to our running list of things to polish and fix up.[/b]

Basically, until the release build is finalized, [b]we’ll be around every single day[/b] to collect and try to solve any problems the community reports, so don’t be shy!

[i](keep in mind we will do our best, but we aren’t going to be able to get to everything!)[/i]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/YrGxBP9.gif[/img]
ME HUNGRY TO SQUISH BUGS...

[h2][b]Our Early Access Journey[/b][/h2]

Since the beginning of early access, we’ve worked with the community to implement [b]140+ more features[/b] over [b]8 major updates to the game[/b]. We are incredibly thankful for everyone's help during Early Access. Thank you for all your suggestions, and feedback. 

While it took an additional 14 months in Early Access compared to what we initially intended, I think it’s safe to say that we’ve put in a ton of hard work to make Sun Haven a game we’re proud of. [i]Sun Haven is a labor of love[/i], and with so many people (ourselves included) with such high hopes for the game, it’s been an immense amount of work to live up to the great things players expect from us.

At the same, we’d also like to apologize to any folks out there who wished that the 1.0 Release would have come sooner. We’re proud of all the work and improvements to the game we made, but we also recognize that it was longer than we expected.


All things said and done, we’re definitely [b]ready to call Sun Haven a complete game[/b]. As such, we’re releasing it fully to Steam, and are leaving Early Access. 

Looking forward, we think there are still things we want to improve. Even though Sun Haven is a complete game, we think we can still make it better, so we will be continuing to update it.

We’re happy to say that despite leaving Early Access, we would love to continue working closely with our community on future changes, just as we already have been.

[h3][b]We Are Still Updating Sun Haven[/b][/h3]
[b]So to make it clear– Going forward, we will still be updating the game both in the short term and in the long term.[/b] We will be updating Sun Haven for years to come. We’re here to support the game and the community, so you can expect more content updates from us going forward.

We thank everyone for waiting patiently as we have poured our hearts into this game to make it the best game possible.

You can take a look at our [url=https://trello.com/b/1cqCSkMp/roadmap]Roadmap[/url] for more information on what our upcoming patches are looking like! Speaking of which…

[h3][b]Nintendo Switch[/b][/h3]
Lastly, we are working with Nintendo to get Sun Haven available on Nintendo Switch as soon as possible. The game has quickly been approaching the quality bar and level of optimization that we want, and as such, has been making great progress.

At this time, the ball is currently in Nintendo’s court, and we are waiting on them in order to continue making progress on our end. As a result, the release of Sun Haven on Nintendo Switch will be pushed out a bit longer, and will go Live as soon as we are given the greenlight, and can finish the port. 

Thank you once again for your patience. We’re looking forward to seeing you all on PBE, and for our 1.0 Release!

[b]-Bruce, Director at Pixel Sprout Studios[/b]

notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone, it’s Bruce from Pixel Sprout Studios.[/b]

It’s been a busy year for us here at Pixel Sprout Studios with getting the[i] Withergate Carnival Update[/i] and the[i] Events & Bosses Update[/i] released to Steam. But hold up, that isn’t all we are delivering this year!

[b]Patch 0.7: Seasons is coming later this month, December 2022.[/b] 

After all, what's the holiday season without a little snow? 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rSbM56R.png[/img]


With the planned release of Patch 0.7: Seasons [b]now being slated for later this month[/b], what does that mean for Sun Haven and its future patches? Well, we’re happy to announce that we have an answer for that- in the form of a brand-new [b][url=https://trello.com/b/1cqCSkMp/roadmap]Roadmap[/url]![/b] On this Trello Board, we have laid out the past, present, and future of Sun Haven! This includes what's coming up for [b]Patch 0.7: Seasons, Patch 0.8 Seasons pt. 2, and our Patch 1.0: Full Release.[/b]
 
[i](*All features listed are subject to change, and the roadmap is not going to be 100% accurate 100% of the time, but we’ll certainly do our best!)[/i]

With the new roadmap, you’ll be able to see everything that’s coming up next for Sun Haven. Speaking of which, let’s talk about what's coming up next!


[h3][b]🌸☀️ 4 Seasons are coming to Sun Haven![/b] 🍂❄️[/h3]

Seasons are almost here, in all their glory! Spring, Summer, Fall, and Winter have come to Sun Haven with beautiful new maps and gorgeous new music to enjoy. From the blossoms of Spring to the cozy snowfall of Winter, we’re so excited to show you how much this town can change over the course of a year.

[b]Each season will feature unique content such as new crops, new dialogue, quests, and more![/b] Here’s a peek at some of the things you will see as the seasons change:

- Seasonal busts and sprites for all romanceable characters
- Unique seasonal decorations
- Seasonal tokens with awesome rewards, such as themed pets and mounts
- Seasonally themed monsters
- Seasonal cooking recipes and crops 
- Seasonal NPCs around Sun Haven

For Nel’Vari and Withergate:
Nivara’s magic protects Nel’Vari from seasonal effects, and in Withergate, Dynus’s darkness keeps the chill out of the air year-round, but don’t worry– these special circumstances won’t exclude Nel’Vari and Withergate romanceable characters from the fun of season changes!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/MXwW1Uc.png[/img]
[i]Hello, Darius![/i]
[h3]
[b]Crafting Update and Farming Skill Tree[/b][/h3]
Along with Seasons, we are adding a lot more to our crafting systems than ever before! The [b]Farming Skill tree[/b] is receiving new updates in this patch with unlockable crafting tables and more recipes locked behind your levels. Over [b]200 new crafting recipes and items[/b] are being added in this patch alone! 

Here’s a sneak peek at just a few of our new crafting tables!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/otc1XHC.png[/img]
[h3]
[b]Mining Systems[/b][/h3]

The [b]Withergate Mines are now open[/b] via the Withergate Subway entrance! Two new vendors have set up shop in the area with brand-new items, armor, potions, and more to discover. Explore nine new mining levels with new ores and unique music tracks in 3 themes.

The [b]Nel’Vari Mines[/b] have also been filled with [b]new monsters[/b] to conquer! Fight new unique monsters as you gather ores and resources for trade with Poppy and Silas outside the mine. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/hs5eLmu.png[/img]

And with that, thank you for reading! Patch 0.7: Seasons will be available on the [b]Public Beta Environment soon.[/b] Thanks for supporting us as we do our best to provide the same outstanding gameplay you’ve come to expect from us every update. Now, join us on our newly revamped Discord to get the latest news about this Patch the moment it drops!

🌸☀️ [i]See you for Patch 0.7: Seasons![/i]🍂❄️


[b]-Bruce, Director at Pixel Sprout Studios[/b]

notes.title: Friday Dev Blog #13
notes.content:
[h3][b]Patch 0.6: Events & Bosses[/b] is just around the corner with a couple of weeks away![/h3] 

[b]Hey Everyone, it’s Bruce from Pixel Sprout Studios.[/b]

In our [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1432860/view/3385036990873242417]Friday Dev Blog #12[/url][/b], we wrote that this patch could potentially be ready in mid-September, but based on PBE discussions and testing, we found we needed more time before we felt confident that the new content was ready for players worldwide.

For the past month, we have had our noses to the grindstone in hopes of minimizing the delay, and we finally have a moment now to give an update on the patch’s final release publicly. 

[b]Our estimation for the full release of this patch is now Friday, November 4th.[/b]

We would like to apologize for the extended delay. While game releases and major updates in the industry do have a history of extended delays, it certainly doesn’t feel great to be on that train as well from time to time. The nature of game development is about making something fun and immersive. With this, you have to take great care to make sure nothing in the game breaks immersion, which can be quite a task.

Between releasing the patch with bugs, or waiting a little bit longer to ensure everything is up to quality bar, we’ve chosen the latter- wait a little bit longer to ensure we’re delivering what players have come to expect from us. We’re very thankful for everyone’s patience and again would like to apologize for the delay.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/S3Bf5tp.png[/img]


On a positive note. [b]This patch is yet again, our largest patch ever.[/b] With revamping Sun Haven Town, adding in 2 new storylines, and redoing our multiplayer system, we’ve made some leaps in bounds in what Sun Haven is, and what it will be in the future. Personally, I’m really excited for what we’ll be able to do with Sun Haven for Patch 0.7: Seasons, now that Sun Haven Town is so developed.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/HkJAHQu.png[/img]
[i]A sneak peek at Winter! This is still a WIP (Work in Progress).[/i]

With more positive news, we haven’t heard of [b]even a single Multiplayer disconnection issue on PBE[/b] since refactoring the Multiplayer system this patch. With this new system that we can reuse, we’re very likely to be able to [b]continue producing multiplayer games that you can play with your friends. Disconnection free.[/b] With a lot of things in game dev, the first time is just the hardest. That’s for sure.

(And now that I’ve said we haven’t had any disconnections, I’m surely just inviting someone to jinx us… uh oh. haha)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ojzer1J.gif[/img]

[h3][b]When will the new patch be live?[/b][/h3]

We’re aiming for both Windows and Mac updates for Patch 0.6. to ship on [b]November 4th.[/b]

[h3][b]What are we still working on for Patch 0.6?[/b][/h3]

[b]Controller Support[/b] is almost finished. We are in some of the final stages of playtesting, and compatibility testing to make sure it functions correctly on multiple types of controllers. To play Sun Haven with a controller, all you’ll have to do is… Well… plug in a controller at any time.

For folks curious about the Steam Deck, we believe everything should be functional and work properly. For our Steam page receiving the Steam Deck support badge, we are likely to receive this at a later date, since it’ll take some time for Valve to verify Sun Haven. Regardless, Sun Haven is playable with controllers. Hooray!

More [b]Multiplayer Bugfixes[/b] are still being worked on. This update should squash many common Multiplayer bugs and practically all disconnection issues, but there’s always more bugs to squash.


[h3][b]What isn’t ready yet?[/b]
[/h3]
A few features we talked about in our last Dev Update aren't fully ready yet, as we needed to spend our time on squashing bugs. These features will come as [b]micropatches[/b] during Patch 0.6 after the initial patch release, or with [b]Patch 0.7: Seasons.[/b]

[b]Expanded Character Customization[/b] is a massive undertaking with hundreds of new options between all the races. The art is all done, but we haven’t had time to implement them into Sun Haven yet.

The [b]Withergate Mines[/b] also has all of the art done, but we will need a bit more time for implementation as well. During Patch 0.6’s release, you will still be able to check out the Withergate Mines’ Subway Hub outside of the Withergate Apartment, but you won’t be able to venture into the Mines just yet.

The [b]UI Update[/b], as intended for Patch 0.6, is completely in the game. However, we’ve heard your feedback about the new HUD UI missing the whimsical, fantasy aesthetic that the old UI HUD had. We’re taking your suggestions into account, and we’re working to re-add some of Sun Haven’s magic to an updated HUD UI for Patch 0.7, further inspired by you. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZSuqyrH.gif[/img]
[h3][b]
Special Thanks![/b][/h3]
Thanks for your patience, and a big thanks to all of the folks helping with PBE testing on Discord. Speaking of which, we would like to shout out some of our most dedicated players for [b]being amazing and incredibly helpful on Patch 0.6’s PBE testing: [/b]

[i][b]Vizzy
Ashesinthend(Yserin)Nospoons
Jet
Eranoth
Gab
Hart
Huskie Moon Fox
KokoroWorlds
Wolf Bite[/b][/i]

You’ve all helped us improve and polish Patch 0.6 into something we can be very proud of. Thank you. And now with the team and help of the community together, we hope to be able to bring [b]Patch 0.6: Events & Bosses[/b] to Sun Haven as soon as it's ready.

We’ll see you with an update soon!

[b]-Bruce, Director at Pixel Sprout Studios[/b]
